Name: Aphrodite Macramé Fringe Dress by Gia Bianca, Handmade
Short description: A handmade macramé dress with draped shoulder cords, a beaded waistband and long fringe, made to be worn over your swimwear.
Description:
The Aphrodite Dress turns a simple swimsuit into a finished outfit. Worn over a bikini or one-piece, its knotted cords frame the body and sway with every step, from the pool deck to a long lunch by the sea.

Details

  • Handmade from knotted cord in a macramé technique
  • Deep V-neckline with a neat knotted edge
  • Loose cord strands draped over the shoulders and upper arms
  • Knotted waistband set with gold-coloured bars
  • Long fringe that falls freely below the knee and opens as you walk

The open, see-through structure is made to be layered over swimwear or a fitted bodysuit rather than worn on its own. The photos show the dress in several colours, so you can see how the design looks in different shades.

Description:
The Khaleesi harness turns a simple bikini or bralette into a complete look. Hand-knotted cord frames your neck, shoulders and torso, and long fringes fall from the shoulders, moving with you as you walk or dance.

Details

  • High macramé collar with a V-shaped centre and a ring of metallic-look tube beads
  • Knotted panel down the centre front, set with tube beads
  • Structured shoulder pieces with long, loose cord fringes
  • Knotted band that sits just under the bust
  • Handmade and ready to wear

The bralette top shown in the photos is not included. Wear the harness over a bikini, a bralette or a fitted top, at the beach, at a festival or for a desert party.

Name: Olympus Handmade Cord Skirt in Gold with Knotted Waistband
Short description: A handmade skirt of layered gold braided cords on a knotted waistband, draped asymmetrically to wear over swimwear at the beach or a festival.
Description:
The Olympus Skirt turns a simple bikini into a finished look. Dozens of fine braided cords drape diagonally across the hips and thighs, so the skirt moves with you and lets skin show through between the strands.

Details

  • Handmade, ready to wear
  • Colour: gold
  • Waistband of knotted cord with gold-tone metal tube accents
  • Layered, asymmetric drape of braided cords that falls to around the knee on one side
  • Open, see-through construction, made to be worn over swimwear or a bodysuit
  • Size: S

Wear it on the beach, at a pool party or as the centrepiece of a festival outfit. Pair it with a gold or neutral bikini top so the cord work stays in focus.
